name: ATTOM
tagline: Nationwide property data with AI-native and MCP delivery.
description: ATTOM is a property data provider covering 160M+ U.S. properties, combining public records — deeds, mortgages, assessor, and tax data — with foreclosure, boundary, and neighborhood datasets. It delivers data through a Property Data API, bulk licensing, Snowflake/Databricks connectors, and AI-native cloud delivery including an MCP server, so AI agents and analytics tools can query property data directly.
insight: Founded in 1996 as RealtyTrac; rebranded to ATTOM Data Solutions in 2016 and sold the RealtyTrac brand to Nations Info in 2022.
edge: Pairs one of the largest US public-records property datasets (160M+) with AI-native cloud and MCP delivery, not just a REST API.
pros: Deeds, mortgage, tax, and boundary data
cons: Data vendor, not an end-user app

references.title: RealtyTrac Unveils Attom Data Warehouse And Rebrands
ATTOM Data Solutions acquired by Lovell Minnick Partners
